flashcard_questions.a: Techniques and conventions used in media products to convey meaning and engage audiences.

flashcard_questions.q: Which category of media codes covers camera techniques, lighting and transitions?
Which category of media codes covers colour, props and costume?
Which category of media codes covers typography, font and language?
Which camera shot shows the subject from the waist up?
Which camera shot shows the subject from the chest up?
Which camera shot shows a very small detail such as an eye?
Which camera shot establishes where the action takes place at the start of a scene?
What effect does a low camera angle have on the subject?
flashcard_questions.a: It makes them look larger, more powerful or threatening.

flashcard_questions.q: What effect does a high camera angle have on the subject?
flashcard_questions.a: It makes them look smaller, weaker or vulnerable.

flashcard_questions.q: Which camera angle is tilted to one side to create unease?
Which camera movement rotates horizontally on a fixed point?
Which camera movement makes the subject appear closer without the camera moving?

notes: 13 cards: 1 term-to-definition, 3 category-to-content, 4 shot-to-framing, 3 angle cards (two as angle-to-effect), 2 movement cards. Each shot front names a unique framing so no two fronts share an answer.
